info.title: policy-service
info.description: Catalogue: insurers, plans, import and publishing. Policies from M4.

tags.name: Profile
tags.description: The calling customer's own policy-holder details.

tags.name: Quotes
tags.description: Server-priced quotes, valid for 30 days. CUSTOMER only.

tags.name: Catalogue
tags.description: Browse insurers and plans. Public: no token needed (PLAN 4).

tags.name: Catalogue admin
tags.description: Insurers and plan import. Insurer admins act only on their own insurer.

tags.name: Policies
tags.description: Buying and viewing my policies. CUSTOMER only.

get.description: CUSTOMER only. The national ID is masked.

put.description: Needed before buying a policy. The national ID is stored encrypted.

post.description: Checks the start date (tomorrow up to 60 days), the plan, eligibility and the module selection, then prices on the server.

422.description: START_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE, NOT_ELIGIBLE or MODULE_SELECTION_INVALID, with details in errors

post.summary: Buy a policy from a quote
post.description: Creates the policy as PENDING_PAYMENT with the quoted premium and the plan's terms frozen, and its premium payment in payment-service. Pay it with POST /api/v1/payments/{paymentId}/pay; the policy becomes ACTIVE once paid. Unpaid policies are cancelled after 24 hours.

503.description: payment-service unavailable (PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE). Nothing was saved; the quote stays open, so try again.

post.description: Takes it off sale. Existing policies keep their own snapshot.

404.description: No such plan, or not yours (PLAN_NOT_FOUND)

post.description: Makes the version immutable and puts it on sale. An older published version of the same plan is retired in the same step (D33).

404.description: No such plan, or not yours (PLAN_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: Not a draft, or a newer version is published (PLAN_NOT_DRAFT, NEWER_VERSION_PUBLISHED)

403.description: Not an admin, or an insurer admin (FORBIDDEN, PLATFORM_ADMIN_REQUIRED)

post.description: Validates the document against the schema and the semantic rules (docs/catalogue-schema.md). With dryRun=true nothing is stored. Otherwise a new version is stored as DRAFT, and an existing DRAFT of the same version is replaced (D34). Maximum 256 KB.

200.description: Valid (dry run) or a draft replaced

404.description: No such insurer, or not yours (INSURER_NOT_FOUND)

409.description: That version is published or retired (PLAN_VERSION_IMMUTABLE)

422.description: Invalid document, every problem in errors (PLAN_INVALID), or the document names another insurer (INSURER_MISMATCH)

get.description: Status is OPEN, USED or EXPIRED.
With members, member numbers, the premium breakdown and the frozen terms.
Modules, options, benefits, limits, waiting rules, exclusions and cancellation of a published plan. Prices come from quotes.

get.summary: List an insurer's plans on sale
get.description: Published plans whose sale period includes today, by name.
Newest first. An insurer admin sees only their own insurer; a platform admin may filter by insurerId.

404.description: The insurerId filter names an insurer you cannot see (INSURER_NOT_FOUND)

ProfileRequest.description: The policy holder's details. Email stays with auth-service.

nationalId.description: Upper-case letters and digits, 5 to 20. Stored encrypted.

ProfileResponse.description: The policy holder's details. The national ID is masked.

QuoteMemberRequest.description: A member to cover. Names are added at purchase.

student.description: Only for children over the plan's child age (student exception).

QuoteRequest.description: What to quote. The server computes the premium; no amount is accepted.

planId.description: A plan on sale, from GET /insurers/{code}/plans.

startDate.description: From tomorrow up to 60 days ahead (D35).

selectedModules.description: Module code to option code. Mandatory modules must be included.

ModuleLine.description: The premium of one selected module option.

PremiumView.description: A premium and how it was built. Every line is rounded to cents.

DeclarationRequest.description: The health declaration (D5): no underwriting, waiting rules apply.

preExistingConditions.description: Whether any member has a pre-existing condition.

accepted.description: Must be true: the customer accepts the terms.

PurchaseMemberRequest.description: A quoted member with their name. The quoted fields must not change (D36).

PurchaseRequest.description: Buy a policy from an open quote.

members.description: The quoted members, in the quoted order, with names.

PolicyResponse.description: A policy with its members and the terms it was sold with.

paymentId.description: The premium payment. Pay it with POST /api/v1/payments/{paymentId}/pay (M4b).

AdminPlanResponse.description: A plan version as staff see it.

CreateInsurerRequest.description: A new insurer on the marketplace.

code.description: Upper-case code, unique on the platform. Plan documents must use it.

id.description: Insurer id. Staff tokens carry it as insurerId.

ImportResponse.description: The result of a plan import.

outcome.description: VALIDATED for a dry run, CREATED for a new draft, REPLACED when a draft was replaced.

plan.description: The stored plan version; null for a dry run.

limit.description: Null when only the parent limits it.

ChildAgeView.description: Child ages, with an optional higher limit for students.

CopayView.description: A co-pay. A PERCENT value is a fraction: 0.1 is 10%.

EligibilityView.description: Who the plan accepts. Ages are in the plan's age basis.

spouseAge.description: Same as principalAge when the plan sets none.

childAge.description: Null when the plan has no children.

LimitView.description: A limit. Amounts in the plan currency.

OptionView.description: An option of a module and its benefit tree.

PlanDetailResponse.description: The terms of a published plan.

filingDeadlineDays.description: Days after an incident within which a claim must be filed.

WaitingRuleView.description: A waiting period and when it applies (docs/catalogue-schema.md, D31).

ModuleSummary.description: A module and its option codes.

PlanSummaryResponse.description: A plan on sale, as listed for an insurer.

id.description: Plan version id; use it for details and, from M4, quotes.

modules.description: Modules and the codes of their options.
